comment: The CJS pass pins superscalar subpaths to that package's CJS declarations: its exports map lists the dist/esm .d.ts under `types`, and moduleResolution node cannot read exports maps at all. The ESM pass (tsconfig.esm.json, moduleResolution bundler) goes through the exports map. At runtime both resolve through node_modules (scripts/link-local-deps.mjs here, the consumer's own install elsewhere).
